Preferred consultation days and times (include timezone)
sections: Purpose
A request for a business review does not create a service contract, book an appointment or authorize a charge. InboxEdge confirms scope and availability before work starts.
Agency contact

TiQology Holdings LLC, doing business as InboxEdge Agency. Business mailing address: 8753 Dunwoody Place STE G, Atlanta, GA 30350. Email: al@inboxedgeagency.com. Telephone: +1 (844) 924-2588. Scheduling

Minimum information

forms.title: Agency services agreement
forms.summary: Define the client relationship, responsibilities, confidentiality and service boundaries.
fields: Client legal entity and business address
Proposed effective date and agreement version
Billing start, renewal and any minimum commitment for agreement
Requested cancellation, refund and service-pause terms for agreement
Ownership, license and confidentiality terms for agreement
Legal-review decisions: governing law, dispute process and liability allocation
sections: Parties and formation

The agency is TiQology Holdings LLC, doing business as InboxEdge Agency. Business mailing address: 8753 Dunwoody Place STE G, Atlanta, GA 30350. Email: al@inboxedgeagency.com. Telephone: +1 (844) 924-2588. The LLC formation state, applicable jurisdiction and client identity must be completed and reviewed before execution; a Georgia mailing address does not establish formation state or governing law. Selecting a package or preparing this document does not form a contract. The final agreement requires authorized acceptance by both parties.
Scope and payment

Only deliverables in a mutually accepted statement of work are included. Public service prices are Basic $500/month, Standard $1,000/month and Premium $2,000/month. Billing cadence, service start, taxes, platform costs, renewal, cancellation, refunds and any setup charges must be expressly agreed before payment. No setup charge is created by this draft. Payment is handled by Stripe; this form never collects card or bank details.
Client cooperation and approvals

Client supplies accurate brand information, lawful audience instructions and authorized account invitations. Client identifies one decision-maker. InboxEdge supplies drafts for approval; silence is not permission to send. Client is responsible for substantiating product and promotional claims. InboxEdge may decline unlawful or unsupported instructions.
Delivery workflow

The final statement of work records discovery, account-access checks, baseline measurement, draft delivery, client review, approved implementation and reporting. Record the responsible person, evidence location and acceptance decision for each milestone. Agree how missing access, delayed client feedback, rejected work and service interruptions affect the schedule before execution; this draft imposes no automatic acceptance or delay charge.
AI-assisted services and execution authority

If AI assistance is included, identify its tasks, approved tools, data boundaries, usage limits, review process and human escalation in the final scope. Preparing content or recommendations does not authorize sending messages, changing accounts, purchasing services or making binding commitments. No customer-list training, cross-client data access or autonomous spending is granted. Additional action permissions require a specific recorded client authorization.
Confidentiality and ownership

Each party restricts confidential information to authorized people who need it for the services and protects it appropriately. The final statement of work identifies ownership and licenses for paid deliverables, agency pre-existing materials and third-party assets. No unrestricted AI training, portfolio use or customer-list reuse is authorized by this draft.
Documents, communications and changes

Identify each final agreement, scope, data-processing addendum and authorization by version and give both parties a reproducible copy. Agree document priority where terms conflict and identify monitored notice addresses. Requests to al@inboxedgeagency.com can be routed to the agency for review; the final agreement must specify formal notice and response procedures. Extra fees, budgets, scope or permissions require a mutually accepted change record before implementation.
Risk and offboarding

Revenue, conversions, inbox placement and platform uptime are not guaranteed. Liability allocation, dispute process, governing law and remedies require final legal review and agreement. Cancellation follows the signed terms and includes access revocation, handoff and documented data return/deletion, subject to lawful retention. This draft imposes no automatic waiver, arbitration obligation or blanket nonrefund term.

forms.title: Package & statement of work
forms.summary: Agree on the exact deliverables, schedule, approvals, fees and exclusions.
fields: Selected package and final scope version
Client legal entity and linked agreement reference
Deliverable-by-deliverable description, owner, quantity and first delivery date
Acceptance criteria, review window and revision rounds to agree
Client decision-maker and approval evidence location
Approved platform / third-party budgets and who pays
Service start, renewal, minimum commitment and cancellation terms to agree
Reporting baseline, attribution settings, data sources and cadence
AI tasks, approved tools, usage allowance and human handoff (if included)
Dependencies, escalation contact and service-pause procedure to agree
sections: Basic — $500/month

Proposed published scope: Klaviyo setup/configuration, a three-email welcome sequence, one promotional campaign per month, basic segmentation and a monthly performance report. Confirm which setup deliverables are one-time and which services recur in the final schedule.
Standard — $1,000/month

Proposed published scope: Basic services, a four-email abandoned-cart sequence, post-purchase flow, four promotional campaigns per month, subject-line testing, advanced segmentation and a strategy call every two weeks. Final schedule must clarify that four monthly campaigns is the total, and agree ongoing maintenance and initial build timing.
Premium — $2,000/month

Proposed published scope: Standard services, win-back/re-engagement, VIP flow, promotional calendar, SMS strategy, revenue attribution reporting, weekly strategy calls and an identified account manager. SMS strategy is not paid SMS activation or a promise of unlimited campaigns. Specify campaign volume and the assigned manager before execution.
Exclusions and acceptance

Platform subscriptions, sending fees, paid SMS, media spend, list acquisition, legal advice and work outside the signed scope are excluded unless expressly priced and approved. Specify measurable acceptance criteria, revision limits, access dependencies and a change-order process. No send occurs before the exact content, segment and timing receive approval.
Delivery and quality record

For each agreed deliverable, retain its version, preview or proof, link checks, audience and suppression checks where relevant, assigned reviewer, approval decision and implementation evidence. Agree the review window and correction process in the final scope. A draft, test message or provider success response is not proof of a customer-approved live launch.
Reporting and attribution

Agree the reporting period, baseline, metric definitions, conversion window and source of truth. Distinguish platform-attributed revenue from verified incremental revenue. Identify data gaps, test traffic and unavailable metrics; do not invent results. Reports must separate recommendations, approved changes and actions actually completed.
Promotion and billing disclosure

If a promotion is offered, record its exact code, eligible package, initial amount, duration, redemption limits and recurring amount after the promotion in the final order and checkout. This preparation page does not issue the requested ONE code or determine eligibility. A promotional initial payment does not change the published recurring package prices unless that change is expressly agreed and accurately presented. Do not collect payment until the checkout accurately presents the accepted offer.

forms.title: Platform access authorization
forms.summary: Approve limited access to the correct Shopify, Klaviyo and related accounts.
fields: Account owner legal name and authorized representative
Platform and account / store public identifier
Invited agency user or partner identity
Requested permission roles and reason for each
Permitted read, draft, edit and execute tasks (separately identified)
Excluded actions and additional approval triggers
Approved data categories, destinations and export restrictions
Client revocation contact and agency access-review contact
Authorization record reference, date and approval status
sections: Least privilege

Use platform-native collaborator, partner or user invitations. The account owner retains ownership and can revoke access. Do not provide passwords, recovery codes, API tokens or payment credentials in this form.
Scope

Approval applies only to the named accounts, roles, tasks and duration. It does not authorize purchases, billing changes, exports, account ownership changes, additional users, campaigns or data reuse unless separately and specifically approved.
Activation and verification

Before any client work, match the invitation to the named client and account, verify the invited identity and actual permissions, and record the acceptance evidence. Keep production and tests distinct. Do not request broader permissions to overcome a denied action; route the missing permission to the account owner. A payment, package selection or completed inquiry does not itself grant account access.
AI and action boundaries

Read-only analysis, content drafting, account edits and live execution are separate permissions. Identify which agency personnel or approved AI tools may perform each task, what data they may receive and who reviews output. Live sending, automation activation and spending remain blocked until the client has explicitly approved the exact action. No authority to make legal, financial or business commitments is implied.
Controls and closure

Use individual accounts and multifactor authentication where available. Keep an access inventory, review permissions and remove agency access during offboarding. Do not share one client's lists, data or credentials with another client.

forms.title: Data processing & confidentiality addendum
forms.summary: Document how client subscriber data may be used, protected, returned and deleted.
fields: Client controller / business and agency processor identities
Approved providers, processing locations and transfer mechanism
sections: Instructions and limits

Define actual legal roles for each activity. Agency processing is limited to documented lawful client instructions for the agreed email services. Do not sell, combine across clients, use for unrelated marketing or train general models on client personal data. Aggregate or redact data before any approved AI-assisted work.
Agency contact and unresolved annexes

TiQology Holdings LLC, doing business as InboxEdge Agency; 8753 Dunwoody Place STE G, Atlanta, GA 30350; al@inboxedgeagency.com; +1 (844) 924-2588. This business contact is not a designated data protection officer appointment. Final processing details, provider list, locations, incident procedure and retention terms must be completed for the actual client before this addendum is signed.
Confidentiality and security

Bind authorized personnel to confidentiality; apply access controls, multifactor authentication where supported, secure transmission, minimum access, separation of client work and a documented incident response. No security guarantee is absolute.
Providers and transfers

List and authorize actual subprocessors and their purposes and locations before use. Address notice/objection procedures, equivalent protections and applicable international transfer requirements. Klaviyo's DPA governs its own processing and does not replace the agency–client agreement.
Assistance and end of work

Agree incident notification without undue delay, assistance with rights requests and assessments, evidence/audit arrangements, and data return/deletion at the client's choice subject to applicable law. Specify a retention schedule and deletion evidence. Applicable privacy laws, annexes and transfer terms require jurisdiction-specific review before execution.

forms.title: Audience source & consent declaration
forms.summary: Record where the audience came from and how opt-outs and permissions are maintained.
fields: List / segment name and approximate count
Consent wording / notice version and evidence location (no subscriber upload)
Purchased, scraped or third-party sources, if any
sections: Evidence, not blanket permission

Identify the actual collection context and applicable lawful basis or consent for each channel and jurisdiction. Keep source/time/notice evidence in the authorized platform. This business declaration is not subscriber consent and does not cure an unlawfully acquired list.
Sending safeguards

Do not import purchased or scraped audiences for agency sends. Preserve suppression lists and honor opt-outs. Do not resubscribe suppressed contacts through imports. Identify the sender accurately, use truthful subjects and include the required postal address and working unsubscribe mechanism.
Shared responsibility

Client and agency each retain their applicable legal responsibilities. Pause disputed audiences until evidence is reviewed. SMS requires a separate lawful channel-specific workflow and provider readiness; email permission alone does not authorize texts.

forms.title: Brand, content & asset brief
forms.summary: Capture voice, audience, offers, approved assets and claims that need evidence.
fields: Asset library location and license owner
sections: Rights and accuracy

Client identifies assets it owns or is licensed to use and the scope of permission. Flag third-party logos, photographs, endorsements and regulated claims for review. Do not assume public availability grants reuse rights.
AI-assisted drafts

Human review and client approval are required before publishing AI-assisted content. Do not put private subscriber data or confidential source documents into unapproved AI tools. No fabricated testimonials, metrics or guarantees are permitted.

forms.title: Campaign / automation launch approval
forms.summary: Approve an exact version, audience, offer and send schedule.
fields: Campaign / flow identifier and immutable version
Approval decision: approve, revise, or reject
Approver name, title and requested changes
sections: Exact approval

Approval must identify the precise content and audience version. Verify rendering, links, sender, postal address, unsubscribe, consent/suppressions and offer accuracy before scheduling. A changed audience, offer, creative or timing requires renewed approval.
No automatic send

Preparing this draft does not publish a campaign, spend money or activate an automation. Service staff must verify the final approval record in the connected workflow and stop if approval is missing or ambiguous.

forms.title: Scope or budget change request
forms.summary: Agree on changes before extra work, fees or access begin.
sections: Mutual approval

Describe the change, cost, timing and effects on the original scope. No additional fee, expanded access, purchase or work is authorized until the final change order is accepted by both parties. Unchanged signed terms continue to apply.

forms.title: Mutual confidentiality agreement
forms.summary: Protect nonpublic information shared during a business discussion.
fields: Both legal parties and business addresses
sections: Limited purpose

Use nonpublic information only to evaluate or perform the stated business purpose. Restrict disclosure to authorized recipients with a need to know and appropriate confidentiality duties; take reasonable protective measures.
Exceptions

Exclude information demonstrably public without breach, already lawfully known, independently developed or lawfully received without restriction. A legally required disclosure is limited to what is required, with notice when lawfully permitted.
No transfer or purchase

Sharing information transfers no ownership, license beyond the stated purpose, service commitment or payment obligation. Final parties, term, remedies and applicable law must be reviewed before execution.

forms.title: Optional testimonial & case-study permission
forms.summary: Choose exactly what results, quote, name or logo may be published.
fields: Exact quote and factual evidence reference
Permitted name, role, company and logo
Approved metrics, date range and attribution caveats
sections: Voluntary and specific

Participation is optional and not a condition of service. Only the final approved quote, identifiers and metrics may be published within the agreed channels and term. No blanket perpetual permission is implied.
Honesty

Do not fabricate, materially alter or guarantee outcomes from a testimonial. Disclose relevant incentives and relationships. Permission does not restrict honest reviews or authorize publication of private subscriber information. Agree a process for future withdrawal and treatment of already published material.

forms.title: Cancellation & offboarding request
forms.summary: Request cancellation and plan account access, exports and handoff.
sections: Request and confirmation

Preparing this draft does not cancel a Stripe subscription or end a contract. Send the request through the monitored service channel; InboxEdge confirms receipt, effective date and any applicable signed notice or refund terms. Do not treat silence as cancellation confirmation.
Handoff

Agree exports, final deliverables, platform ownership, access removal and data return/deletion. Preserve lawful records and suppression requirements. Client retains its own store and marketing accounts; agency must not hold access hostage.

forms.title: Privacy / data request
forms.summary: Ask about access, correction, deletion, objection or consent withdrawal.
fields: Relationship to InboxEdge or named client business
Description and affected systems (no sensitive records)
sections: Verification and routing

Only minimum information should be requested to verify identity and authority through an appropriate secure channel. Do not upload identification documents here. If InboxEdge processes data for a client, route the request to that controller and assist as agreed.
Business contact

Contact TiQology Holdings LLC, doing business as InboxEdge Agency, at al@inboxedgeagency.com or +1 (844) 924-2588. Business mailing address: 8753 Dunwoody Place STE G, Atlanta, GA 30350. This preparation page does not send your request; use the monitored contact channel and retain the acknowledgment.
No automatic action

Preparing this draft does not delete data, stop billing or prove a request has been received. Applicable rights, deadlines and retention exceptions depend on the facts and jurisdiction. Marketing opt-out should remain available through the actual message unsubscribe link without requiring this form.

forms.title: Electronic records & signing choice
forms.summary: Explain the electronic signing process and how clients retain their records.
fields: Documents and versions to be signed
sections: Informed choice

The final signing invitation must identify the documents, ability to decline electronic signing, paper alternatives, contact/update procedures and any relevant withdrawal conditions or fees. Consent to electronic records is separate from agreement to the substantive contract and separate from marketing consent.
Access and retention

Before final acceptance, disclose supported browser, email and PDF/download requirements and let the recipient demonstrate access as applicable. Provide a complete reproducible copy of the final terms and signed record. Do not rely on an editable web page as the only retained agreement.
Signing integrity

The connected signing service must link the verified signer, intent, consent, exact document version and completion time, retain the audit record, prevent silent alteration and deliver copies to authorized parties. Typing a name in this preparation page is not the connected signing process.
